summary: The note describes the Embassy of the Philippines in Bandar Seri Begawan, the Philippines' diplomatic mission to the Sultanate of Brunei. It states the embassy opened in 1984, after Brunei gained independence from the United Kingdom, and gives its current location in the Diplomatic Enclave behind the Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports offices.
one_line: Overview of the Philippines' diplomatic mission to Brunei in Bandar Seri Begawan, opened in 1984.
key_facts: The Embassy of the Philippines in Bandar Seri Begawan is the diplomatic mission of the Republic of the Philippines to the Sultanate of Brunei.
The Embassy of the Philippines in Bandar Seri Begawan opened in 1984.
The Embassy of the Philippines in Bandar Seri Begawan opened in 1984 after Brunei gained independence from the United Kingdom.
The Embassy of the Philippines in Bandar Seri Begawan is currently located in the Diplomatic Enclave of Bandar Seri Begawan.
The Embassy of the Philippines in Bandar Seri Begawan is located behind the offices of the Ministry of Culture, Youth and Sports of Brunei.
